paper.title_en: Generalized Second Law of Thermodynamics in $f(Q)$ Symmetric Teleparallel Gravity
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the validity of the generalized second law (GSL) of thermodynamics on the cosmological apparent horizon in $f(Q)$ symmetric teleparallel gravity, using the Wald-type entropy prefactor $Af_Q/4G$ together with a correction term derived directly from the modified Friedmann equations. We derive, and verify by explicit symbolic computation, a closed-form expression for the apparent horizon entropy in $f(Q)$ gravity and show that its time derivative combines with the matter entropy rate into a remarkably compact master formula, $T_A\dot S_{\rm tot} = 4π\dot H(\dot H f_Q + H\dot f_Q)/H^4$ (in units $8πG=1$), which correctly reduces to the known general-relativistic limit. We apply this formalism to three observationally viable $f(Q)$ models --- power-law, exponential, and logarithmic. We find that the GSL is satisfied throughout cosmic history for all three models, and relate this robustness to a general, theory-independent structural condition: for ordinary pressureless matter obeying the null energy condition, GSL validity reduces to the sign of $\dot H$, i.e., to the absence of a phantom crossing in the total effective expansion history. The geometric sector exhibits model-dependent energy conditions, power-law and exponential models violate only the strong condition, while the logarithmic model violates the null, weak, and dominant conditions for \(z>-1\), and the strong condition for \(z<3.84\).

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文在f(Q)对称远parallel引力框架下研究视界热力学广义第二定律，给出闭式熵表达式与紧凑的主公式，并对三类观测可行的f(Q)模型逐一检验GSL，还提炼出与理论无关的结构性判据，理论深度与清晰度均较好，值得点开细读。
decision.title_zh: f(Q)对称远parallel引力中的广义热力学第二定律
decision.abstract_zh: 我们在$f(Q)$对称远parallel引力的宇宙学表观视界上考察热力学广义第二定律（GSL）的有效性，采用Wald型熵前因子$Af_Q/4G$，并配合直接由修正Friedmann方程导出的修正项。我们推导出$f(Q)$引力中表观视界熵的闭式表达式，并通过显式符号计算加以验证，并表明其时间导数与物质熵产生率结合后得到一个格外紧凑的主公式，$T_A\dot S_{\rm tot} = 4π\dot H(\dot H f_Q + H\dot f_Q)/H^4$（取单位$8πG=1$），该式正确退化为已知的广义相对论极限。我们将这一形式体系应用于三个观测上可行的$f(Q)$模型——幂律型、指数型和对数型。我们发现，GSL在整个宇宙历史中对这三个模型均成立，并将这一稳健性归结为一个普遍的、与理论无关的结构性条件：对于满足零能量条件的普通无压物质，GSL的有效性归结为$\dot H$的符号，即归结为总有效膨胀历史中不存在幽灵穿越。几何部分表现出依赖模型的能量条件，幂律型和指数型模型仅违反强能量条件，而对数型模型在\(z>-1\)时违反零、弱和主能量条件，在\(z<3.84\)时违反强能量条件。
